LanguageData.VRE_InsectJellyDependencyHediff.descript: This person has a genetically-induced biochemical dependency on insect jelly. After 5 days without insect jelly, carriers will suffer from insect jelly deficiency. After 30 days, they will fall into a coma. After 60 days, they will die.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectJellyDependencyHediff.label: insect jelly dependency
